q1.explanationZh: protest 作名词“抗议”，重音在前；作动词“抗议；提出异议”，重音在后。

q2.explanationZh: proud 形容词“自豪的”，常用 be proud of；名词是 pride。

q3.explanationZh: prove 及物动词“证明”，不及物时“结果是”，如 prove (to be) + adj.；名词是 proof。

q4.explanationZh: proverb 名词“谚语”，注意 pro- 开头、-verb 结尾。

q5.explanationZh: provide“提供”，常用 provide sth. for sb. 或 provide sb. with sth.。

q6.explanationZh: province 名词“省”，Jiangsu Province“江苏省”。

q7.explanationZh: psychology 的形容词 psychological“心理的”，注意不发音的 p。

q8.explanationZh: psychology“心理学”，开头的 p 不发音，读 /saɪ/。

q9.explanationZh: pub 是英式英语里的“酒馆，酒吧”。

q10.explanationZh: public 形容词“公众的，公共的”，in public“当众”。

q11.explanationZh: publish 的名词形式是 publication“出版；出版物”。

q12.explanationZh: publish 动词“出版；发行”，注意结尾是 -sh。

q14.explanationZh: pull 动词、名词同形，“拉”，反义词是 push“推”。

q15.explanationZh: pullover 由 pull + over 构成，指从头上套下来的毛衣。

q16.explanationZh: pulse 名词“脉搏”，a rapid pulse“脉搏很快”。

q17.explanationZh: pump 名词“泵”，动词“用泵抽（水、气）”。

q18.explanationZh: punctual 形容词“守时的；准时的”，be punctual for“准时赴……”。

q19.explanationZh: punctuation 名词“标点（符号）”，punctuation marks“标点符号”。

q20.explanationZh: punish 动词“惩罚”，名词是 punishment。

q22.explanationZh: puppy 指“小狗，幼犬”，注意双写 p。

q23.explanationZh: purchase 动词、名词同形，“购买”，比 buy 正式。

q24.explanationZh: pure 形容词“纯的；纯净的”，名词 purity。

q25.explanationZh: purple 形容词“紫色的”，也可作名词“紫色”。

q26.explanationZh: purpose 名词“目的”，on purpose“故意地”。

q27.explanationZh: purpose 加 -ful 构成形容词 purposeful“有目的的”。

q28.explanationZh: purse 名词“钱包；女式小包”。

q29.explanationZh: pursue 及物动词“追逐；追捕；继续；从事”，也常说 pursue a goal“追求目标”。

q30.explanationZh: push 动词、名词同形，“推”，反义词是 pull“拉”。

q31.explanationZh: put“放”，过去式和过去分词都是 put。

q32.explanationZh: puzzle 动词“使迷惑”，名词“难题”；形容词 puzzled“感到困惑的”。

q33.explanationZh: pyramid 名词“金字塔”，注意 y 读 /ɪ/。

q34.explanationZh: quake 名词“地震；颤抖”，是 earthquake 的简称；也可作动词“颤抖”。

q35.explanationZh: make a protest against sth.“对某事提出抗议”，protest 在这里是名词。

q36.explanationZh: be proud of“为……而感到自豪”，介词用 of。

q37.explanationZh: prove (to be) + adj.“证明是……”，prove 在这里是不及物动词，to be 可以省略。

q38.explanationZh: prove sb. (to be) + adj./n.“证明某人是……”，to be 可以省略。

accept: provide sth. for sb. (= provide sb. with sth.)

q39.explanationZh: provide sth. for sb. = provide sb. with sth.“给某人提供某物”，注意两种结构的介词不同。

q40.explanationZh: in public“当众；公开地”，public 前不加冠词。

q42.explanationZh: punish sb. for sth./doing sth.“因为……而惩罚某人”，介词用 for。

q43.explanationZh: on purpose“故意地”，介词用 on。

q44.explanationZh: for the purpose of“为了……的目的”，后接名词或动名词。

q45.explanationZh: put away“把……收起来；放好”，代词要放在中间：put them away。

q48.explanationZh: put on“穿上；上演；打开”，强调“穿”的动作。

q49.explanationZh: put up“举起；搭建；张贴”，put up with 才是“忍受”。

q50.explanationZh: 修饰名词 wool 要用形容词，pure wool“纯羊毛”。

q51.explanationZh: a rapid pulse“脉搏很快”，冠词 a 后用单数名词。

q52.explanationZh: A 后面要用名词，pull 作名词“拉”，a pull on the rope“拉一下绳子”。

q53.explanationZh: 句子缺谓语，讲的是过去的事，用过去式 protested“抗议”。

q54.explanationZh: prove to be“结果证明是”，句子缺谓语，用过去式 proved。

q55.explanationZh: 句子主语要用动名词，和后面的 maintaining 对应，protecting the environment“保护环境”。

q56.explanationZh: The purpose of ...“……的目的”，the 后用名词单数，与谓语 is 一致。

q57.explanationZh: 修饰名词 work 用形容词 purposeful“有目的的”，位于句首首字母大写。

q58.explanationZh: a 后用名词单数，puzzle“令人费解的事”。

q59.explanationZh: pull down“拆除”，房子是被拆，will be 后用过去分词 pulled。

q60.sampleAnswer: The young teacher who is fresh out of school loves the job very much and keeps pursuing excellence, so his colleagues place high hopes on him.
references: The young teacher who is fresh out of school loves the job very much and keeps pursuing excellence, so his colleagues place high hopes on him.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q60.explanationZh: “刚毕业的”= fresh out of school；“不断地追求卓越”= keep pursuing excellence（keep 后接动名词）；“寄予厚望”= place high hopes on sb.。

q61.sampleAnswer: The game proved to be a hard battle, with both sides determined to win.
references: The game proved to be a hard battle, with both sides determined to win.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q61.explanationZh: “被证明是”= prove (to be)，prove 是不及物动词，不用被动；“双方都志在必得”用 with 复合结构 with both sides determined to win。

q62.sampleAnswer: He obtained his doctorate in social psychology.
references: He obtained his doctorate in social psychology.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q62.explanationZh: “获得博士学位”= obtain one’s doctorate；“社会心理学”= social psychology。

q63.sampleAnswer: The pyramid stands there silently, reminding visitors of the power and mystery of the ancient civilisation.
references: The pyramid stands there silently, reminding visitors of the power and mystery of the ancient civilisation.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q63.explanationZh: “让游客们感受到”= remind visitors of，用现在分词 reminding 作伴随状语；“古代文明”= ancient civilisation。

q64.sampleAnswer: The quake destroyed mud buildings in many remote villages.
references: The quake destroyed mud buildings in many remote villages.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q64.explanationZh: “地震”= quake；“摧毁”= destroy，用过去式；“偏远乡村”= remote villages。

q65.sampleAnswer: Internet economy is providing new opportunities for China’s foreign and domestic trade.
references: Internet economy is providing new opportunities for China’s foreign and domestic trade.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q65.explanationZh: “正在为……提供”用现在进行时，provide sth. for sb./sth.；“国内外贸易”= foreign and domestic trade。

q66.sampleAnswer: It is generally thought that talking loudly in public (places) is rude and should be avoided.
references: It is generally thought that talking loudly in public (places) is rude and should be avoided.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q66.explanationZh: “人们普遍认为”= It is generally thought that...；“在公共场合”= in public (places)；动名词短语作主语。

q67.sampleAnswer: This time he won’t be able to escape being punished if he breaks the regulations.
references: This time he won’t be able to escape being punished if he breaks the regulations.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q67.explanationZh: “免不了受惩罚”= won’t be able to escape being punished，escape 后接动名词的被动形式。

q68.sampleAnswer: The new couple spent some money for the purchase of the furniture necessary for their new house.
references: The new couple spent some money for the purchase of the furniture necessary for their new house.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q68.explanationZh: “购买”这里用名词 purchase：the purchase of...；“花钱在……上”常用 spend money on...（手册例句用 on）。

q69.sampleAnswer: By the age of ten, the little girl had published her first collection of poems.
references: By the age of ten, the little girl had published her first collection of poems.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q69.explanationZh: “到 10 岁时已经……”= By the age of ten，用过去完成时 had published；“诗集”= a collection of poems。
